note: Newest first. Add one entry for every deploy players can notice. See CHANGELOG.md.

entries.title: What's new, right in the game
items: A bar at the top of the game now tells you when something new has landed. Tap it to read what changed.
Every update is written down in the new update log, so you can always look back.

entries.title: Your squad, in the room
items: The delve room now shows the heroes you actually sent down.
The sigil rite pays out at a steady pace, and your progress toward the next sigil is kept between visits.

entries.title: Collections and new gear sets
items: New Collections page. Everything you find lights up, and anything still out there stays gray.
New gear sets to find, one for every hero. Wear all three pieces on the right hero for a bonus.
Skills keep every bit of progress between visits, and Vigor and Daring refill properly while you are away.
Hustles can bring back a little extra now and then. Some jobs can also go wrong.

entries.title: Gear and real fights
items: Heroes now wear gear. Weapons, rings, trinkets and armor all change how a fight goes.
Flip a card to see what your hero is wearing and swap things in from your bank.
Delve fights now play out swing by swing, and potions on the belt really get used.
More loot added to the delves.

entries.title: A warmer welcome
items: A fresh front page with the heroes, screenshots and the story of Aldermere.
Signing in is quicker, and the game remembers you on this device.

entries.title: OverSummoned opens its doors
items: The river city of Aldermere is open. Summon heroes, put them to work, and come back to see what they found.
Seven skills to train, delves to send your squad on, and a market where prices move.
